use_case_name: Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas

evidence_cards.content: Used to report the location of fixed ground units or objects (Physical points such as troop concentrations, bridges, airbases, etc.)
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is the exact high-level objective (goal) of the use case as defined by the J3.5 message capability.

evidence_cards.content: Define the objective to report, extrapolate, or associate points, lines, and areas as defined by MIL-STD-6016B, covering slaved positions (true/relative), ASW Areas of Probability (AOP), and nonslaved moving geometries.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the high-level goal of the use case by listing the specific reporting objects (slaved points, AOP, moving areas) that the actor intends to define.

evidence_cards.content: To report an emergency point when the JU has additional or more current information not previously reported, or to assume R2 responsibility for a point due to lack of periodic updates or by operator action.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the primary objectives of the JU in handling emergency points: reporting updates and assuming responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: To report Reference TNs, lines, and areas (including ground points) as those reported by the previous reporting unit, with the latest JU to report having R2 responsibility.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the objective regarding the propagation and tracking responsibility for Reference TNs.

evidence_cards.content: To track alerts for points, lines, and areas by periodically updating emergency points and terminating them if no updates are received within a specified time period (e.g., 10 minutes).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the objective of the Track Alert function regarding the lifecycle and maintenance of point data.

evidence_cards.content: To report Transponder data (Mode 3/A, Mode 4, and IFF Coded) via the T3.1 'and' message, ensuring it applies to the entire line or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the objective of reporting transponder data linked to specific reference points or areas.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall extrapolate the received target's position to the time of transmission to support assigning a Target Quality (TQ) value to a track obtained via a J12.6 Target Sorting message from a non-C2 JU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific action taken by the C2 JU to align data coordinates and times, which is essential for defining geometric reference points and areas.

evidence_cards.content: Transformations for variances and covariances are elaborated for track or target data issuing from needleline PGs, specifically defining the relationship between S (area within which there is a 95% probability that a target is located) and variances/covariances.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides the mathematical basis for defining the geometric area (S) associated with a target track, fulfilling the geometric area definition requirement.

evidence_cards.content: Define point amplification types and geometric areas including Sinker, Brief Contact, Search Center, Estimated Position, Fix, Area of Probability, NOTACK Area, Moving Haven, Sonobuoy Position, Sonobuoy Pattern Reference Position, Limiting Line of Approach, and Friendly Weapon Danger Area (FWDA).

source_locations.location: Lists a-f under 'MIL-STD-6016B' header and lists a-f under 'Other ASW point amplification types' paragraph

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the scope of 'Reference Points and Geometric Areas' as per the use case title, serving as the objective of this documentation section.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU or a JU capable of generating and maintaining track numbers may report an AOP based either on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of the above.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary actor's specific action (reporting an AOP) which directly constitutes the high-level objective of defining a geometric area.

evidence_cards.content: Used to exchange tactical information about geographic references, report the existence of an emergency condition that requires search and rescue efforts, report the location of fixed ground units or objects, and transmit lines, areas, and volumes.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: The document defines the specific purposes of the J3.0, J3.1, and J3.5 messages, which constitute the high-level objective of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 message provides for the description of segmented lines, multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, or ellipses.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific geometric areas and lines that can be defined within the use case.

evidence_cards.content: The objective is to define the transmission, formatting, and identification requirements for segmented lines (J3.0), multisided areas (J3.0), and geometric areas including squares, rectangles, circles, and ellipses (J3.0I/J3.0E0/J3.0C2, J3.5I/J3.5E0/J3.5C3, J3.7I/J3.7C1/J3.7C2).

evidence_cards.content: report the point, line, or area
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: States the primary objective of the C2 JU for moving reference points and areas.

evidence_cards.content: When reported on the Surveillance NPG by a C² JU, a TQ value as specified in Table 4.4-7 shall be initially assigned to a track not locally acquired but obtained via a J12.6 Target Sorting message from a nonC² JU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific objective of assigning a Target Quality (TQ) value to tracks based on their acquisition method.

evidence_cards.content: Generate and report Area of Probability (AOP), Electronic Warfare (EW) Fix, Line of Bearing (LOB), Radio Direction Finding (RDF), or Jam Strobe reports

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the objective of the use case 'Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas' as generating specific types of EW reports including geometric areas (AOP) and reference points (Fix, LOB).

evidence_cards.content: NonC2 JUs shall process J7.0 messages with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, for locally held remote tracks
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a mandatory requirement defining the primary action (goal) for the actor NonC2 JU in the context of Track Management

evidence_cards.content: Each C2 JU shall report on all uncorrelated local ballistic missile tracks and shall assume R² for those tracks in accordance with the R² rules as specified in paragraph 4.4.6.15.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a key objective of the C2 JU: reporting uncorrelated local tracks and assuming R² status, which contributes to defining reference points.

evidence_cards.content: In the event of conflict, the C2 JU shall resolve the difference by transmitting the appropriate J7 message, by operator procedure, or by voice coordination.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the goal of resolving conflicts between local and interface data, which is part of the broader objective of ensuring accurate reference point definitions.

evidence_cards.content: A C² JU or a JU capable of generating and maintaining track numbers may report an AOP based either on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of the above.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the primary actor (C² JU) and the specific action/objective (reporting an Area of Probability or AOP).
